plotLeaflet

Source: R/plotLeaflet.R
plotLeaflet-sites-method.Rd

Plot sites on a leaflet map

# S4 method for class 'sites'
plotLeaflet(object)

Arguments

object

Sites object to plot

Value

leaflet map

Examples

# \donttest{
# Note that by default the limit for queries is 25 records:
tryCatch({
modernSites <- get_sites(keyword = "Modern")
plotLeaflet(modernSites)
}, error = function(e) {
 message("Neotoma server not responding. Try again later.")
})


# }
